description: Source code for low-level 3-way in-core file merge in Git, including built-in and external merge driver support, with functions for merging files, handling merge attributes, and configuration.

classes.name: ll_merge_driver
classes.description: Structure representing a merge driver with name, description, function, recursive option, next driver, and command line.

methods.name: load_merge_attributes
methods.description: Initializes or retrieves the merge attribute check structure.

methods.name: reset_merge_attributes
methods.description: Frees and resets the merge attribute check structure.

methods.name: ll_binary_merge
methods.description: Performs a binary merge, defaulting to conflict or favoring one side based on options.

methods.name: ll_xdl_merge
methods.description: Performs a text-based merge using xdl, falling back to binary merge if files are too large or binary.

methods.name: ll_union_merge
methods.description: Performs a union merge favoring union.

methods.name: create_temp
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with the contents of a given mmfile_t.

methods.name: ll_ext_merge
methods.description: Supports external merge drivers by executing a command line with placeholders replaced.

methods.name: read_merge_config
methods.description: Reads merge configuration from git config, setting up merge drivers.

methods.name: find_ll_merge_driver
methods.description: Finds a merge driver based on attribute or configuration.

methods.name: ll_merge
methods.description: Main function to perform a three-way merge with attribute checks and driver selection.

methods.name: ll_merge_marker_size
methods.description: Retrieves the conflict marker size attribute for a file.
